data.body: CI repair evidence for Change 1847 PS2 preparation. Held-out oracle was the outer repo-isolation lifecycle with cache disabled and xdist enabled; on PS1 it deterministically failed because the nested security-test pytest created `.pytest_cache` in REPO_ROOT. Blind fixer did not see that oracle and changed only the nested child argv: `-p no:cacheprovider` disables its persistent cache, and `--basetemp <outer tmp_path>/nested-pytest` confines remaining runtime artifacts to test-owned storage. Held-out GREEN: 1 passed. Exact-defect mutation (remove those four argv entries) returned the same `.pytest_cache` repo-leak teardown ERROR; restoring the fix returned GREEN. Focused security + autodeploy suite: 13 passed. Ruff check/format and diff check pass. Scope/safety: test-only, no production/workflow/dependency change, no weakened assertion; child still reaches seeded PATH failure and sentinel remains absent. CI_RESULT for PS1: {"run_id":"32098530041","status":"failed","failure_type":"test-failure","failure_details":"all py3.11/3.12/3.13 shards detected nested pytest .pytest_cache leaking into REPO_ROOT","fixes_applied":["disabled nested cacheprovider","redirected nested basetemp under tmp_path"],"retry_count":0}. PS2 will be pushed after the still-pending CI runs finish, preserving one-pending-run discipline.
